explanation: The advisory describes a strict-mode enforcement failure in KMS key provider selection, not a target cryptographic primitive misuse. The diff only adds optional discovery-filter handling for discovery mode and does not demonstrate inadequate encryption strength (CWE-326) or any other covered crypto-misuse rule.
finding: [CRYPTO-009] Weak key length or weak elliptic curve. Use RSA >= 2048 bits or a NIST P-256+ curve. (CWE-326) at src/aws_encryption_sdk_cli/key_providers.py.
